title: Our brand
slide_intent: Introduce the ideas and personality behind the identity so the reader has a basis for judging communications made for different audiences.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can carry a common message across local communications even when their subjects differ.
demonstration: A section divider places a red field beneath a pale curved band. White text announces the subject and previews the role of the guiding ideas.
practical_value: Start here when a brief needs direction on what the communication should mean and how it should sound.
